bio: On the first floor of the luxurious Breidenbacher Hof, overlooking Heinrich-Heine-Allee, this is an elegant brasserie. The cuisine is a broad mix, from sashimi and ceviche to beef tartare or ravioli, not to mention the steaks. They set great store by the origin of their ingredients, working with regional producers – and they keep their own chickens and cows. Decent wine selection....
